justice: Spatial resources are dominated by a wide asphalt carriageway, while pedestrian space is limited to narrow edge strips and curbside margins, suggesting an imbalanced allocation between walking and driving space.

There are some trees and planted strips along the right side and near the far end, which add greenery, but they do not create a strong social or recreational street environment.
No benches, storefronts, bus stops, public gathering spaces, or visible pedestrian activity are present, limiting the sense of everyday street life.

No visible public transport stop, bike lane, or dedicated low-carbon mobility infrastructure appears in the scene, so sustainable travel support is limited.
